artworks.title: Le Mendiant a domicile
artworks.description: The image shows a man standing in profile facing a door, with his right hand poised to knock on it and his left hand holding a top hat behind his back. The man has distinctive facial features, including a long face with a prominent nose and sparse hair that is combed back, revealing a high forehead. He is dressed in a formal, long coat with a high collar, pants, and formal shoes. The background features vertical lines suggesting a staircase area or balcony, with a visible railing.

artworks.title: L'Ami de collège
artworks.description: This image shows two individuals in full length. The person on the left is facing the viewer, slightly bent backward with an expression. They have prominent facial features with exaggerated eyes and eyebrows, straight black hair, and are dressed in dark, long clothing and holding a top hat. The person on the right embraces the first person closely with arms wrapped around their shoulders. Their face is partially obscured, but they appear to wear a top hat and have a similarly elongated form. Their clothing is also dark with a somewhat tattered, long coat or dress. In the background, there is a sketchy depiction of a busy setting with numerous other figures in top hats, outlines of buildings, and cobblestone ground.

artworks.title: Pique-Assiette
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing on a step, looking downward or contemplating. The individual has distinct facial features, wears glasses, a tall top hat, formal attire, and is in a cityscape setting with tall buildings and a horse-drawn carriage.

artworks.title: Le Placeur
artworks.description: The image depicts a man pasting a notice onto a wall. He is standing and leaning slightly forward. The man has a pronounced nose, a pointed chin, short hair visible under a tall top hat, and wears formal attire typical of the 19th century. A woven basket hangs from his right shoulder. In the background, there is a stone pavement and a large cart with wheels partially visible on the right. The wall is covered with various posters or papers.

artworks.title: Le Claqueur
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing in profile with their hands in their pockets, leaning against a wall. They have a determined expression and are wearing a light-colored long coat, dark pants, and shoes. The person's hair is partially covered by a peaked cap and they have a cigar in their mouth, with smoke rising. The background includes textured walls and architectural elements, suggesting an urban setting.

artworks.title: L'Acteur des Funambules
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a snowy night scene outside the entrance of a theater. The central figure is an older individual in a long overcoat, stockings, and a top hat. They are hunched forward, holding papers, possibly a script. Snow is falling around them. To the left, a crowd of onlookers watches from behind a wooden railing. The entrance to the theater reads "ENTREE DES ACTEURS." The drawing is rendered in black and white with detailed line work and shading, reminiscent of Honoré Daumier's style.

artworks.title: Le Portier en tournées de visites...
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the waist up. The person is hunched forward with their head tilted down. They have pronounced facial features, short dark hair, and wear a large top hat. They are dressed in a dark jacket with a textured pattern and a high collar shirt or waistcoat underneath. One hand is tucked into the waistcoat, while the other is clenched into a fist and positioned to the side. The background is light-colored with subtle vertical lines.

artworks.title: Pour qui sont ces Serpents...
artworks.description: The image displays a person from head to waist, with arms raised and hands open. The person has animated facial features, such as wide, round eyes and an open mouth. They have dark, curly hair with a wreath entwined in it, wearing a robe or tunic. There are no accessories or objects visible. The background has a textured pattern.

artworks.title: J'ai vu Seigneur... votre malheureux fils...
artworks.description: This print shows two men. The man on the left is in profile, looking to the right at the other man. He has exaggerated features, with a sloping nose, a wide, downturned mouth opened to reveal a few large teeth, and a weak, flabby chin. His eyes are large and wide, and his eyebrows are raised high on his forehead. His arms are extended outward, towards the other man. The man on the right has his arms crossed and his shoulders raised in a shrug. He faces us, but his eyes look towards the right. He has a large, round nose, wide eyes, and raised eyebrows. His closed lips are downturned, and he has a dark beard and mustache. Both men have light skin and dark, curly hair, and they wear draped cloth garments. The background is mostly off-white paper, with some darker shading in the area between the men. Words are written faintly at the bottom of the paper.

artworks.title: Je pars plus amoureux que... jamais...
artworks.description: The image shows a caricature of two individuals from the waist up. The person on the left is leaning forward with their hands clasped over their chest, facing the person on the right. This individual has curly hair and an elongated profile with a prominent nose and appears to be wearing a loose, draped garment. The person on the right is standing upright and looking forward with a neutral expression. They have a long face with subtle features and straight hair partially covered by a headpiece resembling a tiara, and their attire suggests a flowing dress with a cloak or veil attached at the shoulders. The background is a simple, textured shading that enhances the figures' outline and provides depth to the image.

artworks.title: Ulysse et Pénélope
artworks.description: The image shows two people partially visible from the chest upwards, lying in a bed. One person is reclined with their head resting on a pillow and is covered up to the chest with a blanket. They have an angular face with defined features and are wearing a head covering. The other person is leaning over them, supporting themselves with their arm and smiling. This person has a round face with short dark hair. Both are dressed in loose, slightly rumpled clothing, likely bedclothes. The setting inside appears domestic, with a decorated large clock on the wall above the bed. The background suggests an interior room with simple decor, emphasizing the bed and the individuals within it.

artworks.title: Le Supplice de Tantale
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene involving natural elements and a fanciful depiction of food. The artwork shows a tree with exaggeratedly large fruits hanging from its branches, including grapes and other round fruits. Beneath the tree, there is a table setting on the water, consisting of a bird-like creature emerging from a dish and two wine bottles nearby. The composition is dynamic, with lines that suggest movement, as seen in the swirling leaves and flowing branches. Above the tree, two birds are depicted in flight. The overall scene has a whimsical, surreal quality, incorporating elements of satire and fantasy.

artworks.title: Télémaque interrogé par les sages
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three figures sitting on stone stairs with another figure standing in front of them. The seated figures wear robes and one is reading from a large book. The standing figure is draped in a dark cloth. In the background, more figures in robes observe the scene. Trees fill the upper part of the composition, implying an outdoor setting. The drawing features strong lines and shading, creating depth and expression in a scene that may suggest a philosophical discourse or a satirical assembly.

artworks.title: Pygmalion
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a sculptor looking at a partially complete human-like figure emerging from a block of stone. The sculptor has exaggerated features and wild hair, standing facing the sculpture. Sketches and fragments of other sculptures surround them on the wall. The stone figure leans forward with one arm extended. The background includes sketched details like the outline of various studies or artwork.

artworks.title: Le Futur monument de Napoléon aux Invalides
artworks.description: Four individuals are shown from head to toe, bent over and observing something on the ground. On the left, a man wearing a black top hat and brown coat is bending forward. Next to him, a woman is wearing a yellow and red scarf on her head and a black dress, also bending forward. In the center, a small child with short light brown hair is dressed in light-colored clothes and is bent over, looking at the ground. To their right, an older man in a navy blue coat with a white sash looks down, carrying a sword and holding a circular hat. The background shows a light-colored wall with column shadows, suggesting an architectural setting.

artworks.title: Impressions de voyage d'un grand poete
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a street scene in front of a butcher shop. The image depicts a figure balancing a large cut of meat on its shoulder. To the right, there are hanging meats displayed prominently. Two figures stand in conversation near the shop entrance. A dog is running in the foreground. The ground has swirling lines. The style conveys a lively atmosphere.

artworks.title: Les Journaux bienfaisans
artworks.description: This is a painting of an interior scene with two men in conversation. One man is gesturing animatedly while the other listens attentively. In the background is a large cabinet filled with various objects, including a parrot, a taxidermied animal, books, and glass displays. Beside the men is a window with the word 'CAISSE' on it. This painting is done in the style of Honoré Daumier.

artworks.title: Dites donc, mame Giboulard...
artworks.description: Two elderly women in hooded shawls and dresses mop the street. They have weathered faces, with one woman wearing a tighter hood and the other with a broader nose and open mouth. They hold mop handles on wet ground with puddles. In the background, there are people and building facades suggesting a busy urban street scene.

artworks.title: L'Entrée dans la vie
artworks.description: The image shows three adults and a baby. Two women and a man are seated in the background, while another man is standing in the foreground. The man on the right is holding an unclothed baby. The man on the left is standing in less formal attire. Behind them, two women are sitting draped in cloaks. The background features a draped curtain and a framed picture or mirror on the wall.

artworks.title: Un Voyage d'agrément a Paris
artworks.description: The image depicts a group of men in a street setting. Central figure standing with arms slightly extended, holding papers. Other men surround him, all dressed in long coats and hats. Background shows a carriage wheel and outlines of a building with partial text. Crowd extends into the distance, creating a busy street scene.

artworks.title: Vois-tu, mon ami... il n'y a que deux élemens... du bonheur...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of three individuals gathered around a table under a leafy canopy. Two individuals are seated at a wooden table, while a third stands beside them. The seated individuals have varied poses, one leaning forward attentively and the other wearing a hat with a striped pattern. The backdrop is dense with foliage creating a textured, intricate contrast to the white space around them. The style is sketch-like with emphasis on shading and line work, displaying the figures and greenery.

artworks.title: Une Révolte a bord
artworks.description: This is a drawing of individuals in a boat named "Le Bas Billon". The scene depicts a small rowboat on a water body, with one person in a top hat standing on the boat holding an oar and observing two other individuals in the boat. The figures are rendered with detailed expressions. The background features a calm horizon line with sparse indications of distant land or figures. The boat's name is prominently displayed on its side. The use of shading and line work emphasizes the drama and movement within the scene.

artworks.title: Ah! ben... le convoi... peut se flatter de l'échapper...
artworks.description: Two men are separated by a wooden fence. The man on the left is wearing a dark suit with a long coat and a top hat. He is leaning over the fence and looking at the man on the right. The man on the right is kneeling on one knee, holding a stick or thin object and wearing a loose-fitting outfit with stripes on the lower leg. He has a full beard and a broad-brimmed hat with the letters "M.L.B." The background shows a sketched, rocky landscape or large hill beyond the fence.

artworks.title: Allons donc... que diable cocher...
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse-drawn carriage traveling quickly. It shows the front view of the carriage being pulled by a horse. The open-topped carriage contains four figures. The horse is detailed, and its posture suggests movement. In the background, there is an explosion with curved lines indicating motion and a chaotic scene. The drawing is in black and white, emphasizing contrast and shadow.
